Monday Night Meander

Peoria, AZ · Social · Mixed

Beginner friendlyNo-drop

Monday Night Meander is a social group ride in Peoria, AZ. It rolls every Monday at 7:00 pm from West Valley Casual Bike Rides meet spot. About 15–20 miles, casual. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 7:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: casual. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Monday Night Meander group ride

A casual 15–20 mile Monday evening ride in the West Valley. The group's motto is 'nobody gets left behind.' Any bike and any fitness level. The same group also runs a Wednesday sunrise ride and a Thursday night ride.
